mcat_description.short: PVC Portable Cabin is a prefabricated, relocatable small structure built with PVC or UPVC wall panels on a mild steel or GI frame, sold as a complete ready-to-install unit. It is primarily used as a security guard cabin or portable site office in India.
mcat_description.long: PVC Portable Cabins are factory-built, modular structures using PVC or UPVC panels for walls and roofing, supported by a mild steel (MS) or GI tubular frame, and are designed for rapid on-site installation without a permanent foundation. In the Indian B2B market, the dominant application is as a security guard cabin or guard room at gated communities, construction sites, industrial premises, and commercial complexes. Larger variants serve as portable site offices, labour colony units, or portable toilet enclosures. Key material differentiators include wall panel thickness (typically 6mm PVC), frame gauge, insulation type (plain PVC, PUF-insulated, or EPS panel), and cabin dimensions, which are typically customised to buyer requirements.

market_context: In the Indian B2B market, PVC Portable Cabins are prefabricated modular structures primarily sold as security guard cabins for gated communities, construction sites, and industrial premises, with PVC panel walls (typically 6mm thickness) on an MS tubular frame. The market uses 'PVC cabin,' 'PVC security cabin,' 'porta cabin,' and 'guard room' interchangeably for the same product. Material variants include plain PVC panel, PUF-insulated PVC panel, EPS panel, and UPVC — with PUF-insulated variants commanding a premium for all-weather use. Manufacturers are concentrated in Chennai, Delhi NCR, Ahmedabad, Mumbai/Thane, and Bengaluru. The category overlaps with FRP portable cabins and MS security cabins, which are direct material substitutes competing in the same buyer segment; buyers often compare PVC vs FRP vs MS options before purchase. No dedicated BIS/IS standard governs PVC portable cabins specifically; structural integrity claims (wind resistance up to 120 km/h, seismic zone III-IV compliance) are manufacturer-stated, not third-party certified in most cases (single source — low confidence for specific structural ratings). Sizes range from compact 4x4 ft guard booths to 20x10 ft site offices, with custom dimensions widely available.
